indeclinable adverb reinforcing universality of place
negation particle denying the presence of distinction
object denoting difference or special condition

items.question: Does the sādhaka's conduct admit any distinction depending on place or location?
premises: All places are included without exception.
Everywhere is treated as equivalent in scope.
No distinction is permitted in any location.
items.inference: Therefore the sādhaka's conduct must remain undifferentiated across all places.
items.plain_english: In all places and everywhere, there should be no distinction whatsoever.
